verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.

xrefs.text: It is just as the Scripture says: “Anyone who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.

Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow to you facedown and lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; those who hope in Me will never be put to shame.”

verses.text: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.

xrefs.text: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.
A prayer of David. Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear to me; answer me quickly when I call.
O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
For their rock is not like our Rock, even our enemies concede.

verses.text: For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.

xrefs.text: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.
to shine on those who live in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace.
They will not hunger or thirst, nor will scorching heat or sun beat down on them. For He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.
Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.

verses.text: You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.

xrefs.text: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.
The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
They spread a net for my feet; my soul was despondent. They dug a pit before me, but they themselves have fallen into it! Selah
Then they will come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil, who has taken them captive to his will.

verses.text: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.

xrefs.text: Then Jesus called out in a loud voice, “Father, into Your hands I commit My Spirit.” And when He had said this, He breathed His last.
While they were stoning him, Stephen appealed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,

verses.text: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.

xrefs.text: I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.
Those who cling to worthless idols forsake His loving devotion.
No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God. And I do not want you to be participants with demons.
He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
But they are altogether senseless and foolish, instructed by worthless idols made of wood!

verses.text: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.

xrefs.text: Shout for joy, O heavens; rejoice, O earth; break forth in song, O mountains! For the LORD has comforted His people, and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones.
In all their distress, He too was afflicted, and the Angel of His Presence saved them. In His love and compassion He redeemed them; He lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.
Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.

verses.text: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.

xrefs.text: Indeed, He drew you from the jaws of distress to a spacious and broad place, to a table full of richness.
How could one man pursue a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the LORD had given them up?
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.
He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.

This day the LORD will deliver you into my hand. This day I will strike you down, cut off your head, and give the carcasses of the Philistine army to the birds of the air and the creatures of the earth. Then the whole world will know that there is a God in Israel.

verses.text: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.

xrefs.text: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.
My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.

verses.text: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.

xrefs.text: From my youth I was afflicted and near death. I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.
There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.
When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
So He ended their days in futility, and their years in sudden terror.
I have deep sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.

verses.text: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.

xrefs.text: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.
You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
But this has all happened so that the writings of the prophets would be fulfilled. Then all the disciples deserted Him and fled.
You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.
“A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”

verses.text: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.

xrefs.text: I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.
Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
You will break them with an iron scepter; You will shatter them like pottery.

It will break in pieces like a potter’s jar, shattered so that no fragment can be found. Not a shard will be found in the dust large enough to scoop the coals from a hearth or to skim the water from a cistern.”
Does not the potter have the right to make from the same lump of clay one vessel for special occasions and another for common use?

verses.text: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.

xrefs.text: For I have heard the whispering of many: “Terror is on every side! Report him; let us report him!” All my trusted friends watch for my fall: “Perhaps he will be deceived so that we may prevail against him and take our vengeance upon him.”
When morning came, all the chief priests and elders of the people conspired against Jesus to put Him to death.
You summoned my terrors on every side, as for the day of an appointed feast. In the day of the LORD’s anger no one escaped or survived; my enemy has destroyed those I nurtured and reared.
Then Saul hurled his spear at Jonathan to kill him. So Jonathan knew that his father was determined to kill David.
Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking false testimony against Jesus in order to put Him to death.

verses.text: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”

xrefs.text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
A Miktam of David. Preserve me, O God, for in You I take refuge.
I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.

verses.text: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.

xrefs.text: Jesus replied, “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.
To everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.
Therefore Jesus told them, “Although your time is always at hand, My time has not yet come.
Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.

verses.text: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.

xrefs.text: Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.
Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.
Restore us, O God, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness, even though we have rebelled against Him
So now, our God, hear the prayers and petitions of Your servant. For Your sake, O Lord, cause Your face to shine upon Your desolate sanctuary.

verses.text: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.

xrefs.text: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.

But the LORD is with me like a fearsome warrior. Therefore, my persecutors will stumble and will not prevail. Since they have not succeeded, they will be utterly put to shame, with an everlasting disgrace that will never be forgotten.
It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
Behold, all who rage against you will be ashamed and disgraced; those who contend with you will be reduced to nothing and will perish.

verses.text: May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.

xrefs.text: They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
to execute judgment on everyone, and to convict all the ungodly of every ungodly act of wickedness and every harsh word spoken against Him by ungodly sinners.”
Do not boast so proudly, or let arrogance come from your mouth, for the LORD is a God who knows, and by Him actions are weighed.
No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their vindication is from Me,” declares the LORD.
But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.

verses.text: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!

xrefs.text: Rather, as it is written: “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no heart has imagined, what God has prepared for those who love Him.”
From ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides You, who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him.
They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,
Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.

verses.text: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.

xrefs.text: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, and will not fear havoc when it comes.
Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,

verses.text: Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.

xrefs.text: When Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah, he said, “God has delivered him into my hand, for he has trapped himself by entering a town with gates and bars.”
Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes.
But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.

Now behold, this day I have made you like a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land— against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests, and the people of the land.
A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.

verses.text: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.

xrefs.text: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”
During the days of Jesus’ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.
How much less, then, when you say that you do not see Him, that your case is before Him and you must wait for Him,
The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.

verses.text: Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.

xrefs.text: Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.
The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.
Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.

verses.text: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.

xrefs.text: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,
Strengthen the limp hands and steady the feeble knees!
being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience, and joyfully
The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
